subject: Pilot credit approval for Olive Labs — Accelerator cohort
messages:
From: Sasha Reed <sasha@olivelabs.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olive Labs Partnerships <partners@olivelabs.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credit approval for Olive Labs — Accelerator cohort

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking time on Tuesday. Olive Labs is confirmed for the Fall accelerator cohort (starts Sep 8) and we'd like to run a two-week proof-of-concept on your hosted inference offering. The pilot will exercise our summarization + search reranking flow and we estimate ~6M tokens during the PoC.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide promotional credits and a short trial extension so we can run the PoC without gating? Specifically we are requesting: 
- $10,000 in hosted inference credits (promo)
- 90-day trial extension from activation date

Attached is a short pitch deck showing the POC goals and timelines (OliveLabs_pitch_deck_v2.pdf). Our acceptance window for the cohort onboarding is Aug 22 — would appreciate confirmation before then so we can finalize the accelerator program materials.

Let me know what documentation you need (SLA exceptions, technical contacts, MOU). Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Sasha Reed
Head of Partnerships, Olive Labs
Sasha Reed | sasha@olivelabs.ai | +1 415-555-0199
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot credit approval for Olive Labs — Accelerator cohort

Jordan / Marcus — forwarding Olive's ask below. They want $10k + 90-day extension to run a Sept PoC tied to an accelerator start date.

Quick context: Olive is a program partner in SF; small team but good potential to convert to a Dedicated account if the PoC shows cost sensitivity improvements with our batching/caching suggestions. They plan ~6M tokens for the PoC.

Questions for you: 
1) Is an approval in principle possible from growth/partnerships for $10k promo credits?
2) Any constraints from finance/legal on the extension window or the credit amount? We should document limits (hosted-only credits, non-transferable) in the MOU.

I'll draft an MOU if you want — attaching their deck for reference. If we can approve in principle today I can send a conditional MOU back to Sasha and route for signature.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 20:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot credit approval for Olive Labs — Accelerator cohort

Kimberly — thanks for flagging. Approve in principle from GTM for a promotional allocation, but recommend we cap at $7,500 for the initial PoC and include a milestone release for any top-up (after a conversion signal or usage review). Finance prefers a two-step approval rather than larger up-front promos.

Marcus — please confirm no contractual blockers on a 90-day extension and that we mark credits as hosted-only (no Dedicated/private deployment refunds). If legal wants explicit indemnities or data handling language in the MOU we should include that.

If everyone is OK I support Kimberly sending a conditional MOU to Olive with DocuSign.

—Jordan
VP, Growth Partnerships
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Reed <sasha@olivelabs.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credit approval for Olive Labs — Accelerator cohort

Hi Sasha — thanks for the deck and for the run-through earlier. Good news: we can support your accelerator PoC with a conditional promotional allocation.

Summary of approval (conditioned on signed MOU):
- Promo credits: $7,500 hosted-inference credits (applied to the account upon activation)
- Trial extension: 90 days from activation date
- Coverage: credits apply to Redwood hosted API only (not Dedicated or Private deployments)
- Usage cap: credits will be consumed on a first-in, first-out basis; we will share token-level billing during the PoC for transparency

I have attached a draft MOU for your review (MOU_draft_OL-2025-042.docx). Please review and sign via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/OL-2025-042. Once signed, we will provision the credits and confirm activation window.

Two asks to finalize: 
1) Please confirm expected activation/start date for the PoC (you mentioned Sept 8).
2) Confirm the primary technical contact for onboarding (we'll assign a solutions engineer for integration).

If you need a slightly larger allocation after we review early usage, we can discuss a milestone top-up; Jordan recommended an initial cap that we can revisit after the first two weeks of the PoC.

Deadline for sign-off to meet your accelerator materials timeline: Aug 22. If you need any edits to the MOU before routing to legal, let me know and I can iterate quickly.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
